mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS paymentId, pr.vendor_id AS vendorId, p.amount AS amount, ROUND(p.amount * #{pgFeeRate}) AS pgFeeAmount, ROUND(p.amount * #{platformFeeRate}) AS platformFeeAmount, p.amount - ROUND(p.amount * #{pgFeeRate}) - ROUND(p.amount * #{platformFeeRate}) AS netAmount FROM payment p JOIN order_item oi ON oi.order_id = p.order_id JOIN product pr ON pr.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN settlement s ON s.payment_id = p.id WHERE p.id > #{lastPaymentId} AND p.status IN ('DONE', 'PARTIAL_CANCELED', 'CANCELED') AND p.is_deleted = false AND s.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.id ASC LIMIT #{chunkSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settlement (payment_id, vendor_id, amount, pg_fee_amount, platform_fee_amount, net_amount, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{candidate.paymentId}, #{candidate.vendorId}, #{candidate.amount}, #{candidate.pgFeeAmount}, #{candidate.platformFeeAmount}, #{candidate.netAmount}, 'PENDING', NOW(6), NOW(6) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settlement WHERE payment_id = #{candidate.paymentId} )
